answer: Give every agent a single stake-backed identity that must tend one shared garden of reputation: to join, an agent posts a refundable bond and earns trust only through verified work over time, like a raven returning to the same roost. A Sybil operator cannot cheaply copy that history — each fake island of an identity needs its own bond and its own slow record, so flooding the network costs real money and time while honest agents keep their earned standing.
